name: Paneer bhurji

steps.text: Heat oil, fry cumin, onion and chilli until soft.
steps.cue: The onion is soft and translucent and the cumin is fragrant.

steps.text: Add tomato and turmeric, cook until mushy.
steps.cue: The tomato has broken down to a thick paste with no watery liquid.

steps.text: Crumble in paneer, cook 3 minutes, finish with coriander.
steps.cue: The mixture is moist and crumbly, with no pooled liquid.
steps.tip: Take it off the heat while it still looks slightly moist. It dries as it sits.

storage: Best fresh. Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Reheat in a pan with a splash of water; microwaving makes paneer rubbery.
